$comment: Versioned performance budgets for CircleUp. Update only with measurement evidence. Baseline changes require measured rationale (before/after numbers, environment, and reason) recorded in the change description. Fixtures must remain deterministic and fully offline: no live Stellar RPC, no private production data, and no real user records.

fixtures.$comment: Production-like, deterministic, offline fixture tiers used to exercise these budgets. Sizes are bounded so the suite stays fast in CI while covering realistic joins, histories, and page states.

small.description: Minimal/empty states and single-record edge cases

highWater.description: Upper bound of realistic production scale (bounded high-water mark)

fixtures.determinism: Fixtures are generated from fixed seeds; no network access, no live database, no private production data.
fixtures.safety: All records are synthetic and contain no real user data.

environmentVariance.note: CI runners are slower and noisier than local machines; budgets include this headroom.

circleListHighWater.$comment: High-water tier: 100 circles with full member joins

bundle.$comment: Next.js page JS budgets (gzipped). Measured with `next build` output. Exceptions documented below.

homePage.$comment: Includes React runtime and shared chunks

createPage.$comment: stellar-sdk adds ~15 KB gzipped; exception granted until tree-shaking is implemented

$exception.stellar-sdk: stellar-sdk cannot be tree-shaken without bundler config changes; tracked in issue #todo

render.$comment: Component and data preparation time budgets in ms measured in Node.js runtime. These are ceiling values, not targets.
render.$comment_highWater: High-water tier render/preparation ceilings (256 members, 100 contributions per member)

payload.$comment: Wire payload size budgets (uncompressed) for the initial circle list in different states
payload.$comment_highWater: High-water tier wire payload ceiling for circle detail with 256 members
